fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) declined 23.1% over three months but is expected to benefit from expanded AI application adoption and datacenter infrastructure expansion.
fields.summary_ko.1: By establishing long-term agreements (LTA) with 14 major customers, over 50% of production capacity through 2027-2028 has been secured, with cloud service providers' capex expected to increase over 60% in 2027.
